title: Osimiri nke kpughere obi
intro: Chee echiche banyere ndị agha na-aga ije, akpịrị kpọrọ nkụ ma nwalee, ebe otu onye agha n'akụkụ osimiri ga-ekewapụ mkpebi siri ike na ọchịchọ. Onye ndu ahọpụtara na-edu ndị agha ahụ gaa n'ebe onye iro dị ike nọ, na-ebu ntụkwasị obi na Allah naanị.
clues: Allah họpụtara m dịka onye ndu ụmụ Izrel mgbe ha rịọrọ maka otu onye ga-alụ ọgụ n'ụzọ Ya.
E nyere m ihe ọmụma na ogo dị ukwuu dịka ihe ịrịba ama nke nhọrọ m, mana ndị m na-ajụ ikike m.
M gara soro ndị agha wee gwa ha na Chineke ga-eji osimiri nwalee ha.
Adọọla m aka na ntị na onye ọ bụla ṅụrụ mmanya n'enweghị nsogbu agaghị abụ onye m, ma e wezụga onye ṅụrụ obere ihe.
M gafere na mmadụ ole na ole kwụsiri ike, na-eche ndị agha karịrị akarị ihu.
Eduru m ndị kwuru ugboro ole obere ụlọ ọrụ na-emeri nnukwu ụlọ ọrụ site n'ikike Allah, tupu e merie Jalut.

trial.label: Nnwale/Ihe Omume
options: M na-ehi ụra n'ọgba ruo ọtụtụ afọ
Ịnwale ndị agha ahụ site n'osimiri tupu agha amalite
Ịbụ onye azụ̀ dị egwu loro
trial.answer: Ịnwale ndị agha ahụ site n'osimiri tupu agha amalite

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: Mgbanwe ghọọ enwe maka mmebi iwu
Mmeri site n'ikike Allah, Dawud gburu Jalut.
Mmiri na-emikpu n'oké osimiri ya na ndị ọbịa
outcome.answer: Mmeri site n'ikike Allah, Dawud gburu Jalut.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
